name: Freelane
summary: A bold business bank app for freelancers, with a balance forecast and pots that split every payment
about: A business banking app for a one-person business or small studio, in a loud neo-brutalist style. A chart shows your balance and a 30-day forecast built from the invoices you are owed and the bills you have scheduled. Every payment that lands pours into a tax pot, a rainy-day pot and spending money in an animated split, and invoices, cards, transfers and insights sit alongside.
how: Read your balance and the widening forecast band for the next 30 days; switch history between 30D, 90D and 6M.
Mark an invoice paid and watch the payday split pour it into Tax, Rainy day and Spending.
Drag the split rules on Pots to change your percentages, or type any amount and press Pour it to try it.
Write invoices with line items, discount and tax and a live paper preview; set one to Paid to split it.
Make a virtual card for a job or subscription and freeze it in one tap.
Send money from your main account or a pot, schedule bills, and check if your tax pot is ready on Insights.
